THEATRE AND FILM — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: THEATRE AND FILM
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Theatre Design: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Theatre Design.
   B. Practise Theatre Design with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Theatre Design.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Theatre Design.

4. Best practice when working on Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   B. Disrupt classmates during Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   C. Damage equipment used for Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2..
   D. Practise Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Theatre and Community: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Theatre and Community with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Theatre and Community.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Theatre and Community.
   D. Damage equipment used for Theatre and Community.

6. Best practice when working on Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT.
   D. Damage equipment used for Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT.

7. Best practice when working on Acting: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Acting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Acting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Acting.
   D. Practise Acting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Theatre Adjudication: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Theatre Adjudication.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Theatre Adjudication.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Theatre Adjudication.
   D. Practise Theatre Adjudication with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

10. Best practice when working on Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1.
   D. Damage equipment used for Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1.

11. Best practice when working on Play Writing: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Play Writing.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Play Writing.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Play Writing.
   D. Practise Play Writing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Poetry writing – Spoken word: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Poetry writing – Spoken word.
   B. Practise Poetry writing – Spoken word with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Poetry writing – Spoken word.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Poetry writing – Spoken word.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Acting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. C — The speed of the music

3. B — Practise Theatre Design with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Play Writing 1.3 Poetry Writing 2.0 Production 2.1Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Theatre and Community with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Theatre Adjudication 3.2 Theatre and Community Page 15 of 47 1 STRAND 1.0: CREAT with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Acting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Practise Theatre Adjudication with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. A — Practise Acting 2.2Theatre Directing 2.3 Theatre Design 3.0 Theatre, Film and Society 3.1 with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Poetry writing – Spoken word with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
